data.description:
BUILDPLAN.md T-15a (M3).

The sandbox: a Docker image with the pinned toolchain and nightly Miri — **the pin (`rustc -Vv` release and commit-hash, the nightly's date) is defined here, once** (`SPEC.md` §7.2, D-17) — run with no network, memory/CPU/pids limits, read-only root, tmpfs work dir, hard timeout; the AC-12 fixture suite proven on it

Criteria: AC-12
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-01
BUILDPLAN notes: Serialized on `justfile`

Workflow mode: inline-full. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

PR base is ai-c11-cc/repo-scaffold until #8 merges; fly, push and PR commands run in your tab with the client's approval. ORCHESTRATOR: PR #8 merged to main at 0742d35 (merge commit; your base commit 2ab95e3 is its second parent). From now on: rebase onto origin/main (git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main; it should be a no-op or trivial), and open your PR against main, not ai-c11-cc/repo-scaffold. Drop the 'Based on #8' line from the PR body.

ORCHESTRATOR: PRs #9 (shared web layer) and #10 (bank format) merged to main: 36250b3 then 238146e. main now carries web/shared/** and the bank format. Their branches were auto-deleted. Rebase onto origin/main (git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main), base your PR on main, and read web/shared/typemodel.js from main rather than the old branch.

DONE PQ-19 PR https://github.com/mrojas54/rust-nyc-pop-quiz/pull/12 HEAD ff99bd27914293e2738de33a193f26d525041ea2 BASE 0742d3578726e3e0486c7b3793c6bb934e3e8579 (origin/main; origin/ai-c11-cc/repo-scaffold no longer exists, see deviation 1) test-warm 0.71 s

deviations:
1. PR is against main, not stacked on ai-c11-cc/repo-scaffold. #8 merged at 2026-09-20T22:07:26Z mid-ticket and its branch was deleted. main @ 0742d35 has a tree byte-identical to 2ab95e3, so I rebased onto it. The PR body's 'Based on #8' line is replaced with an accurate one. No retarget needed.
2. The platform is not pinned. The image builds natively, and pin.toml's target_triples lists both linux-gnu targets. The first plan pinned linux/amd64; plan-review finding 6 reversed it. D-17's pin is the same on both architectures, SPEC 3.2 treats the triple as a recorded field, and emulation would slow Miri on the client's Mac.
3. Not asked for but needed: the image tag carries a 12-hex Dockerfile digest as well as the versions. sandbox-build skips a tag that already exists, and with only the versions in the tag, a Dockerfile fix under an unchanged pin was skipped as already built. That happened during this ticket, and a test now stops it.
4. A bare pytest in pipeline/ now errors on tests/sandbox: its conftest refuses unless POPQUIZ_SANDBOX_SUITE=1, and just test passes --ignore=tests/sandbox. I chose an error over a skip so the Docker suite can never look green without having run.
5. Beyond the five named fixtures, the suite also checks that the image's rustc -Vv matches the pin, that Miri needs no network, that a trivial program runs under a 'miri' mode, and that the container is gone after the timeout.
6. The justfile header comment used to say setup is the only recipe that touches the network. Amended: sandbox-build does too, and neither is reachable from test.

notes:
- AC-12 is proven on both architectures. aarch64: locally, just test-full exit 0 in 1:12, with the containment suite at 9/9 in 67 s. x86_64: CI run 35684269267, test-full job SUCCESS, 9/9 in 63 s, host x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu. Cold image build with no layer cache: 120 s.
- The pin was recorded from the image, not typed: 1.98.1 / 48a229ceaefd4985c50990b14116b6d856af0985, nightly-2026-09-19, miri 0.1.0 (420ed2a0c3 2026-09-18).
- Not proven, and the README says so: --cpus throttles and never kills, so the timeout bounds a runaway; no fixture forks, so --pids-limit is set but not exercised; MEMORY_LIMIT is inferred from exit 137/134 when the module did not do the killing.
- For T-15b:
  - popquiz.sandbox.read_pin() is the only pin reader.
  - The shell-out guard now allows exactly src/popquiz/sandbox.py, and fails on a stale exemption too. RealRunner should call run_in_sandbox rather than add a second exempt module. Use sandbox.RunnerTimeout instead of importing subprocess.
  - T-15a does not record target_triple; that is T-15b's job.
  - The run mode compiles fresh in every container, so N runs are N independent containers.
  - The miri mode is minimal: no strict provenance, no Tree Borrows. That is T-15b's.
  - MIRI_SYSROOT is set in the image; without it Miri tries to re-stage its sysroot on the read-only root.
- Environment:
  - These needed the sandbox bypass: the 1Password signing socket, the uv cache, the Docker socket and ssh to GitHub.
  - .lattice writes also needed it until the carve-out was added mid-session.
  - The c11 socket timed out twice and recovered.
  - The Docker daemon was not running at start; I started Docker Desktop with the client's approval.
- Contract: no defects found that need a fix. The ticket metadata's 'PR base: origin/main' turned out correct once #8 merged. EVALUATION's 'CI installs Docker' wording means the ubuntu runner's existing Docker, which the job asserts.

PR #12 merged to main at 696b3ce with a merge commit on the client's word, after both CI jobs passed on the exact head ff99bd2. Code review PASS-WITH-NITS on f6fdf21; AC-12 proven on aarch64 and x86_64. Pin recorded from the image (1.98.1 / 48a229c, nightly-2026-09-19). Handover notes for T-15b on PQ-20.
